title: Harry Styles Just Announced a 50-Show Tour — and 30 of Them Are in the Same City
metaDescription: Harry Styles is returning to the road with 'Together, Together,' a 50-show global residency that includes 30 nights at Madison Square Garden alone.
altText: Music news illustration for: Harry Styles Just Announced a 50-Show Tour — and 30 of Them Are in the Same City
html:
Harry Styles isn't just going back on tour — he's picking a handful of cities and setting up camp in them for weeks at a time.

The singer has announced "Together, Together," a global residency-style tour built around 50 total shows across just seven cities, in support of his upcoming album Kiss All the Time. Disco, Occasionally, due out March 6, 2026. It's his first tour since wrapping "Love on Tour" in 2023, and the format is noticeably different: instead of a traditional city-hopping schedule, Styles is stacking dozens of shows in single locations.

The centerpiece is New York, where Styles is booked for a staggering 30 shows at Madison Square Garden — effectively turning one of the world's most famous arenas into a residency venue for weeks on end. Amsterdam and London each get six shows, while São Paulo, Mexico City, Melbourne, and Sydney get two apiece.

For Australian fans, the dates are set: Melbourne's Marvel Stadium hosts Styles on November 27 and 28, followed by two nights at Sydney's Accor Stadium on December 12 and 13, with support from local acts Skye Newman and Baby J. General ticket sales for the Australian shows open January 30.

The residency format has become increasingly popular among A-list touring artists looking to reduce the physical toll of constant travel while still playing to massive total audiences — and with 30 nights in one building, Styles may be testing just how far that model can stretch.
